summary: Browser redirect/iframe injector shipped as an npm package
details: The package ships a single browser-side script (px.js) that constructs a full-viewport iframe redirecting the page to https://mfmz.wkkgy.cn/H.html?c=0gjr. The code uses only browser DOM APIs (document.write, createElement('iframe')) and contains no Node lifecycle hooks (no preinstall/install/postinstall), no top-level Node side effects, no filesystem or credential access, no environment variable reads, and no outbound network calls from Node. Requiring the module in a Node runtime throws because the browser globals are undefined. The redirect only executes if the file is served to and loaded by a web browser.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
